job.title: QA & Release Lead | Quality Engineering & Automation
job.description:
I am recruiting on behalf of a long-term client, a multi-award-winning trading and risk management software provider serving the energy and commodities markets.

With an international presence across Australia, the UK and the USA, and clients in more than twenty countries, the business develops technically sophisticated software used in pricing, analytics and risk management.

The opportunity

This is a senior technical leadership role for someone who enjoys both improving the way QA is done and getting into the work themselves.

You will lead a small QA team, drive quality engineering practices, own release management and contribute directly to testing, automation and technical investigation.

The role is suited to an experienced QA manager or technical QA lead who has retained strong practical skills and does not want to move into a position that is exclusively about managing people and distributing tasks.

The role reports to the Head of Engineering and is based in Sydney CBD, with a hybrid working arrangement.

What you will be doing
  • Lead, mentor and develop a small QA team while remaining technically involved in the work.
  • Improve and evolve the existing Python-based test automation framework, including integration, regression and end-to-end testing.
  • Design and execute test scenarios, including functional, integration and regression testing.
  • Write SQL queries for test validation and investigate application and database behaviour.
  • Work across APIs, integrations and enterprise software to identify and troubleshoot quality issues.
  • Own release readiness, regression testing, production verification and continuous improvement of the release process.
  • Establish quality metrics, improve testing effectiveness and promote quality engineering practices across the engineering organisation.
  • Manage application licensing, ensuring provisioning aligns with client contracts and coordinating renewals with relevant stakeholders.
What we are looking for

You will bring robust experience in software QA, including experience leading a QA team or QA function. Just as importantly, you will be comfortable remaining close to the technical detail.

You should be able to demonstrate:
  • Strong experience with test automation, including improving existing automation suites rather than simply managing their execution.
  • Practical experience designing and executing functional, integration, API and end-to-end testing.
  • The ability to write SQL queries for test validation, ideally in a SQL Server environment.
  • The ability to read and understand Python code used in test automation. Experience modifying or writing Python automation is highly desirable.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to work through calculations and technical testing scenarios.
  • Experience with source control, defect-tracking tools and quality metrics.
  • Experience with release management and coordinating software delivery across engineering and other stakeholders.
  • Experience leading, mentoring or developing QA professionals.
  • A quantitative degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or a related discipline.
Experience with quantitative or financial software, C#/.NET, enterprise applications or distributed systems would be advantageous.

A note about the selection process

This is a technically involved role. The selection process includes a practical assessment designed to explore your hands-on capability.

This will likely  include quantitative reasoning, writing SQL statements and reading Python code, alongside technical testing scenarios.

The assessment is intended to understand how you approach practical QA and engineering problems, not simply your experience managing a team.

Is this you?

You may be a QA Manager, QA Lead, Senior QA Engineer or Quality Engineering Lead. The title matters less than your ability to combine technical depth, leadership and practical contribution.

If you enjoy leading people but also want to remain close to the technology, testing and engineering problems, this could be a strong opportunity.

You must have unrestricted rights to work in Australia and be able to access the Sydney CBD office.

I am interviewing now. Please apply online, email jorge@extendconsulting.com.au or contact Jorge Albinagorta on 61 (0) 439 781 736 if you meet the criteria and are genuinely interested in the role.

job.title: Quantitative Support Analyst
job.description:
The Company

I am recruiting on behalf of a long term client who is experiencing sustained growth and success across the regions they operate in. They are a multi-award winning trading and risk management software provider to the energy and commodities markets.

With offices in Australia, UK and USA, they have a strong international client base with clients in over twenty countries. Backed by a European energy exchange company, this organisation has been recognised as a global software leader for energy and commodity pricing and analytics.

The Role 

With the ever increasing number of customers and existing team members executing their career progression plans, my client is continuing to invest in the team focused on providing excellent client experiences, post implementation.

To join this team, my client is looking to retain a driven Quantitative Support Analyst who will investigate, test and resolve product and service queries, offering information and education through in-depth knowledge of my client’s product / solutions.

This is a full-time, hybrid role based in London, UK.

The primary duties and responsibilities of this role include, but are not limited to, the following:
  • Manage the ticket queue system, providing remote support to our global customer base
  • Manage the resolution of customer product or service problems through troubleshooting technical issues, determining the root cause of the issue, managing the escalation if required and communicating the progress and solution to the client.
  • Applying your quantitative and mathematical knowledge to understand my client’s platform to investigate and resolve tickets
  • Demonstrate a solid commitment to customer service focusing on quality and timeliness of communication and feedback.
  • Contribute towards support and training documentation, both creation and maintenance.
  • Participate in client training.
Required Skills / Attributes

To be successful in this role you will likely have a quantitative analyst / actuarial background, as well as an understanding of university level mathematics and strong desire to apply your statistical, analytical, programming and finance knowledge.

Experience working in the energy and commodities markets and/or knowledge of trading, valuation and risk analytics would be a massive advantage, but not essential.

You will be self-motivated, be able to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges and situations.

Additionally, you will likely have and be able to demonstrate:
  • A client centered approach and excellent communication skills.
  • A bachelor’s degree, or higher, with a quantitative or finance emphasis.
  • Exposure to quantitative methods and/or finance.
  • Ability to self-organise, multi-task and deliver to deadlines.
  • Being a self-starter with the ability to work independently as well as part of an international, multi-location team.
  • Experience with Excel/VBA and SQL (Knowledge of C# would be an advantage)
Is This You?

You must have unrestricted rights to work in The UK.

A test of your technical skills will be part of the selection process.

I am interviewing now so please apply online, email jorge@extendconsulting.com.au or contact Jorge Albinagorta on 61 (0) 439 781 736 via WhatsApp. I would love to share more with you if you are genuinely interested in the role and you feel you meet the position criteria.

Thank You!
